gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text pulls wide entrances into every curve and lets its lowercase fill most of the line height, which feels literary and dignified. Groovy's near-shut c is the funky foil.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-pridi: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy bends every arm and leg at one constant width, like cable twisted into letters, while Pridi's refined serif strokes swell and thin. Their strongest quality is that tension.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-scope-one: Scope One keeps its ascenders stubby and its x-height big. Groovy does its best work as a loose, single-stroke headline with a nearly closed c, while the text serif below lets its counters spill open and handles the steady reading.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px brings a bookish, dignified text serif with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. And Groovy, funky and loosely tracked, sits above it with lines like a bent straw.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-suwannaphum: Groovy's lowercase is loosely tracked and its c almost seals itself, with every arm and leg drawn at a constant width and no brush-like swelling. Suwannaphum follows with a dignified, editorial serif whose tall x-height and open c give the pairing its real bite.
gen-dafont-groovy-instrument-sans: A narrow slit nearly closes Groovy's c, and its loosely tracked lowercase has a friendly, funky bounce that grabs attention fast. Instrument Sans handles the quiet work, with open pincer-like c shapes.
gen-dafont-groovy-inter: Groovy's c almost closes into a narrow slit, and its constant-width arms and legs give the heading a funky, friendly wobble. Inter opens everything back up, and that tension is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-groovy-mulish: Mulish reads modern and approachable, with horseshoe-open apertures and no thick-thin modulation. Groovy earns its keep when it is big and short, its funky loose letters carrying a heading.
gen-dafont-groovy-rubik: Friendly and funky up top, Groovy tracks its lowercase loosely and nearly seals each c, while Rubik below uses big, open round letters that stay clear at small sizes. Expect a soft, easy rhythm over many lines.
